body_sources: Measured by pipeline/build_body_grid.py from USGS Astrogeology Mars MGS MOLA DEM 463 m (https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/mars_mgs_mola_dem_463m): 111.2 km patch of 60 x 60 points 1853 m apart centred on each 1-degree point, sampled bilinearly. Accessed 2026-11-14.
